description: social.md §9.2 react aggregation with the default/1 palette (§9.1): entries, (react, qkey) grouping (qkey per lfm-1.md §11), contradictions, Fv/Av restricted to E, the reactCreate, reactSecond and reactAnti gates, the creator (greatest K, ties by the smallest DID). input: {fold: FoldInput}. expected: reacts = {subject uri: [{react, qkey, creator, supporters, opposers}]} for valid reacts only, each list sorted by (react, qkey) bytes; supporters include the creator. Generated by testdata/vectors/social-ref/gen_social.py from the reference model (testdata/vectors/social-ref/lessdugin_ref); do not edit by hand.

vectors.name: supporters-9-invalid
vectors.note: alice (K 9, in E) is the only one reacting `insightful`: 9 < reactCreate 10 (karma/1 default), so C is empty and the react is not valid. mona's `seen` is a control

vectors.name: supporters-10-4-one-supporter
vectors.note: alice (K 10) passes reactCreate and creates the react; bob (K 4) fails reactSecond 5, so the supporters are alice alone

vectors.name: supporters-10-5-two-supporters
vectors.note: alice (K 10) creates the react; bob (K 5) passes reactSecond 5 and seconds it

vectors.name: anti-19-ignored-20-counted
vectors.note: mona (an authority) creates `wrong`; carl (K 19) and dave (K 20) are against it: only dave passes reactAnti 20

vectors.name: contradiction-dropped
vectors.note: alice (K 10) is both for and against `crux` (same qkey ""): that group is dropped, so mona (an authority) alone supports crux and alice is neither supporter nor opposer. Her other entries stand: `insightful`; `typo` against without a quote and `typo` for on "teh" are different (react, qkey) groups, so both yield. typo/"" has no supporter and is not valid

vectors.name: same-qkey-two-quotes
vectors.note: qkey (lfm-1.md §11) = norm(trim_ws(exact)): alice's "  the  cat\n" and bob's "the cat" (other prefix, suffix) share qkey "the cat" and form one react (alice K 10 creates it, bob K 5 seconds it); alice's second entry with the same qkey collapses with her first; adam's "the dog" is a separate react. mona's "Cafe\u0301" is NFC-normalised to bob's "Caf\u00e9": one `crux`, created by mona (bob, K 5, is not in C) and seconded by bob

vectors.name: creator-tie-by-DID
vectors.note: insightful: alice and bob both have K 10, so the creator is the smaller DID (alice). important: carl (K 11) has the greatest K and is the creator although his DID sorts after alice's

vectors.name: authority-creator-and-greatest-K
vectors.note: authorities pass every gate whatever their K: mona (K 0) creates `crux` alone (bob, K 4, fails reactSecond). For `insightful` the creator is the u ∈ C with the greatest K: alice (K 10) rather than mona (K 0); mona is a supporter

vectors.name: voters-outside-E-or-banned
vectors.note: nemo has K 10 but no membership (he left), so he is not a participant and not in E; nell is a member with K 10 from a single seed (seedUp 1 < establishSeeds 2), a newcomer outside E. Both pass reactCreate and reactSecond, but reacts by voters outside E are never counted. mona is a moderator banned by the owner: she would pass reactAnti (an authority), but her opinion does not count at all (O4)

vectors.name: voting-karmaOnly
vectors.note: policy.voting = karmaOnly: reacts count only under `reacts`, so adam's react is stored but ignored

vectors.name: voting-twoAxis
vectors.note: policy.voting = twoAxis: reacts count only under `reacts`, so adam's react is stored but ignored

vectors.name: voting-reacts
vectors.note: policy.voting = reacts: the default; adam's react counts

vectors.name: restrict-react-and-vote
vectors.note: mona is restricted from `react`: her reacts are ignored (her opinion still counts). adam is restricted from `vote` only: his karma axis is ignored, his react counts

vectors.name: self-react-ignored
vectors.note: O3: mona's react on her own post is ignored; adam's counts

vectors.name: entry-rules
vectors.note: a react id outside the default/1 palette is ignored and an unknown stance discards its entry (OP3); a missing stance means `for`. `wrong` has only opposers (adam, owner), so C is empty and it is not valid

vectors.name: reactSecond-above-reactCreate
vectors.note: gates reactCreate 0, reactSecond 100, reactAnti 0; alice, bob and carl are granted seeds with K 0. alice and bob are both in C (tie on K: the smaller DID, alice, creates); nobody passes reactSecond, so supporters = {creator}; carl's against counts (K 0 ≥ 0)

vectors.name: qkey-normalisation
vectors.note: qkey = norm(trim_ws(exact)) exactly as lfm-1.md §11 orders it (NOTES.md 35): trim_ws runs first, so mona's "teh \u200e" keeps its space once the control is removed (qkey "teh ", not "teh"); controls are removed ("c\u0007a\u202et s\u001bat" -> "cat sat"); a quote of White_Space only has qkey "" and groups with adam's unquoted `seen` (the smaller DID, adam, creates it)

vectors.name: hidden-spam-and-deleted-subjects
vectors.note: a hidden subject still collects reacts; reacts on a spam subject are void (O5); an opinion whose subject is in `absent` counts only toward karma, never toward reacts

vectors.name: approval-preset
vectors.note: approval mode with the approval preset (reactCreate 0, reactSecond 0, reactAnti 5): granted members with K 0 create (alice, the smaller DID) and second (bob); erin is an applicant (not granted, so not in P or E) and is ignored; carl (K 0) fails reactAnti; dave (K 5) is an opposer

vectors.name: subject-kinds-and-order
vectors.note: reacts apply to posts, comments, wikiRevisions and sequences; each subject's reacts are sorted by (react, qkey) bytes: agree < changed-mind < crux < not-a-crux

vectors.name: gates-are-retroactive
vectors.note: alice's karma came from 10 boosters, but the owner nullified one of them: that vote no longer counts (O4), so K[alice] = 9 < reactCreate and her react disappears (§8: gates use the current K). mona's `seen` is a control
